text:
Marta Ibarra: Hey folks — I opened a docs PR (#4218) that adds a compact migration checklist and updated SDK snippets for the Optimize toolkit (batching, kv-prefetch, quant profiles). Need a quick sanity pass on examples and any stale links.

Kevin Liu: On it. Which snippets are you most worried about? the Python stream examples or the Go microbatch one?

Marta Ibarra: Python and Go both. Python shows a small batching example using `batching_hint` and `kv_prefetch=true`. Go example was copied from an older API and might still reference `BatchConfig` (which we replaced with `BatchOptions`).

Julia Park: I skimmed the PR — two things jumped out: 1) a link to the internal prefetch design doc points to /deckhand/optkit-old, should be /deckhand/optkit-prefetch (internal redirects are flaky). 2) the fenced code block in the Go snippet uses triple backticks with a stray trailing space which broke the docs build in my local mkdocs run.

Samir Dutta: Also FYI the quant profile examples include a short-seq profile that assumes int8 quantization on LLaMA-2-13B. We should add a note about model variance and recommend a smoke eval. Something like: "Run the eval harness on 100 prompts with short/long distribution to validate accuracy delta."

Marta Ibarra: Good catch both. I'll update the link and the Go fence. For the quant note — added to the checklist as an item and included a small `pytest` snippet suggestion.

Kevin Liu: Quick code nit — Python snippet currently: `client.generate(model="optimize-v1", batching_hint=4, kv_prefetch=True)`. Our SDK prefers snake_case for params but the API expects `kv_prefetch` as snake_case only in SDK v0.9+. Can we opt to show the JSON request body instead? Less SDK-version-y.

Julia Park: Showing the JSON request body is a safe neutral approach. Add a comment that SDK param names changed in v0.9+ with a link to the SDK migration guide. Also add `# noqa` or escape sequences for any inline backticks that confuse markdown rendering in the docs pipeline.

Samir Dutta: I ran the examples locally against a tiny mock and saw the Go microbatch sample still uses `BatchConfig.MaxTokens` (camelCase) — update to `batch_options.max_tokens` and illustrate the new boolean `enable_kv_prefetch`.

docs-bot: build/docs site preview: https://deploy-preview.redwood/docs/4218 — build succeeded with warnings (1 link warning, 2 lint warnings).

Marta Ibarra: Thanks! I'll push a follow-up with the fixes in ~30m. Who can do final review once I update? @Kevin @Julia?

Kevin Liu: I can take the Python + links.

Julia Park: I'll recheck the Go snippet and the mkdocs rendering. :thumbsup:

Marta Ibarra: Great — assigning reviewers in the PR. If build preview still reports the link warning after I change the path, I'll open a quick redirect PR in deckhand.

Samir Dutta: One last thing — add a tiny regression test under docs/tests that runs the Python example snippet and asserts it returns a 200-like response from the mock. Prevents silent rot.

Marta Ibarra: Will do. Closing the loop here after the patch. Thanks all! :pray:
